name: Search bar with typed query and suggestions
description: A large white rounded search bar (search icon, no logo) in the middle of the frame; a query types in letter by letter with an orange caret, then the bar rises and up to four suggestion rows slide in below it (search icon, typed words in bold); a cursor hovers one row and clicks it, turning it orange-tinted.
use_when: Lines about looking something up or asking the internet: 'so you google how to...', 'I searched for...', 'everyone is searching for...', tutorials, research, 'how do I' questions.

query.help: what gets typed, lower case reads most natural, e.g. 'how to edit videos faster'

suggestions.help: up to 4 suggestion lines; include the query words so they show in bold; under ~45 characters each; [] shows only the typing

pick.help: index of the suggestion the cursor clicks (0 = first)
